mint noun

the herb

also peppermint, mint tea

classical

Ov.
Plin.

menta (mentha), mentae f.

noun, first declension

M-O’s own example is mentae īnfūsum, mint tea.

Examples

  • mentae ipsīus odor animum excitat

    the very smell of mint revives the spiritPlin. NH 20.147

Other words

  • menta piperāta — peppermint

    also used · modern · M-O, pharmacy Latin

See also herbal tea, thyme, sage.
